title: Speaker for the Dead
author: Orson Scott Card
summary: Three thousand years after a famous war, a man travels to a quiet colony world to speak the truth about a dead person's life. There he meets the only other intelligent species humanity has found since.
readIf: you like philosophical science fiction about understanding other beings and telling the truth about the dead.
skipIf: you want another fast, military story, as this is slower, more reflective and very different in tone.

pairings.reason: A thoughtful novel about a visitor learning to see another culture without judgement.
A classic about contact with beings far beyond us and what it means for humanity's future.
A hopeful, scientific take on first contact, balanced by questions of faith and trust.
